newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber quiet, except for lone RSS3 deal.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber quiet, except for lone RSS3 deal.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was quiet on Monday except for a solitary deal for RSS3 rubber in the ring session, dealers said.
"Somebody was closing their position and hit the spot July contract for 100 tonnes. That was the only piece of business this morning. There was nothing else done," a dealer said.
Dealers said the market was looking for leads going into the afternoon session in otherwise slow trading conditions.
Prices were indicated at lower levels as a result of easier prices in Japan, the traders said.
The key November contract in Tokyo shed 1.2 yen to reach 132.0 in the morning session.
"The major consumers are not in the market so far, but I wouldn't be surprised if they're checking prices to see if an opportunity will present itself," a dealer said.
At 0445 GMT, August RSS3 was indicated at 111.50 U.S. cents a kg from last Friday's settlement of 112.50 cents.

August RSS1 was indicated at 160.00 Singapore cents (US$1.12) a kg from 161.25 cents. July TSR20 was indicated at 147.50-149.50 Singapore cents (US$1.03-$1.05) a kg from 149.50 cents. - (S$1.42 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
